command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=56813b27f6dc1f93d4899974ffd47a1528d8b6b8
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller
test "$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('src/climate/rf433/Rf433RmtLoopback.cpp')
text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
text = text.replace('#include <esp_err.h>\n', '#include <esp_err.h>\n#include <esp_log.h>\n', 1)
needle = '''  if (rmt_receive(rx_channel_,
                  rx_symbols_.data(),
                  rx_symbols_.size() * sizeof(rx_symbols_[0]),
                  &receive_config) != ESP_OK) {
    ++diagnostics_.rx_arm_errors;
    return false;
  }
'''
replacement = '''  const esp_err_t rx_arm_status =
      rmt_receive(rx_channel_,
                  rx_symbols_.data(),
                  rx_symbols_.size() * sizeof(rx_symbols_[0]),
                  &receive_config);
  if (rx_arm_status != ESP_OK) {
    ESP_LOGE("rf433_rmt",
             "rmt_receive failed err=%s code=0x%x min_ns=%lu max_ns=%lu resolution_hz=%lu",
             esp_err_to_name(rx_arm_status), static_cast<unsigned>(rx_arm_status),
             static_cast<unsigned long>(kRxMinimumSignalNs),
             static_cast<unsigned long>(kRxMaximumSignalNs),
             static_cast<unsigned long>(kRmtResolutionHz));
    ++diagnostics_.rx_arm_errors;
    return false;
  }
'''
if needle not in text:
    raise SystemExit('rmt_receive diagnostic anchor not found')
path.write_text(text.replace(needle, replacement, 1), encoding='utf-8')
PY
git diff --check
PORT=$(.venv/bin/python -c 'from tools.stage27c_soak import detect_ch340_port; print(detect_ch340_port())')
echo "STAGE28B_PORT=$PORT"
export PORT GROWBOX_FIRMWARE_GIT_SHA="$EXPECTED" GROWBOX_STAGE27_SD_ENABLED=1 GROWBOX_STAGE27_FLASH_FALLBACK_ENABLED=1 GROWBOX_SD_CMD0_PRECONDITION=0 GROWBOX_RF433_LOOPBACK_ENABLED=1 GROWBOX_RF433_LOOPBACK_AUTO_SMOKE=1 GROWBOX_RF433_TX_GPIO=8 GROWBOX_RF433_RX_GPIO=14 STAGE27C_BUILD_DIR=build/idf-stage28b-rf-rx-arm-diagnostic-v1
scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh flash
OUT=/tmp/stage28b-rf-rx-arm-diagnostic-v1
rm -rf "$OUT"
.venv/bin/python tools/stage27c_soak.py --port "$PORT" --output-dir "$OUT" --duration 45 --progress-seconds 15 --expected-sha "$EXPECTED" --require-sd --strict
grep -h 'rf433_rmt.*rmt_receive failed' "$OUT"/raw-*.log | tail -n 5
test "$(grep -hc 'rf433_rmt.*rmt_receive failed' "$OUT"/raw-*.log | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s+0}')" -ge 1
git reset --hard "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
printf 'STAGE28B_RF_RX_ARM_DIAGNOSTIC_OK\n'
